features: Safe & Sound Listening (85 dB Limit): Protect your child's developing hearing with a dedicated volume-limiting button that keeps audio strictly capped at a safe 85 decibels. This protective restriction guarantees that whether they are watching high-action cartoons or playing educational games, the sound never hits unsafe, ear-straining levels.

Tuned for Kids with 40mm Drivers: Give your little ones a rich acoustic experience that brings their entire digital world to life. These custom-voiced 40mm dynamic drivers are engineered specifically for younger ears, striking the perfect balance between crisp, high-clarity vocals for school lessons and a warm, energetic sound for dancing along to their favorite music tracks.

Soft & Plush Earcups: Treat sensitive ears to the ultimate cloud-like cushion design. The ear shells are covered in a premium, ultra-soft padding material that applies minimal pressure, keeping your child perfectly cozy while preventing skin irritation during online school modules

All-Day Wear Comfort: Keep distractions at bay during long learning stretches or extended weekend family road trips. The entire chassis is structurally optimized to balance clamping pressure evenly, ensuring the headset sits gently over their head without inducing fatigue or midday headaches.

Lightweight Yet Durable Build: Invest in a sturdy companion that easily survives the rough-and-tumble nature of childhood play. Engineered from highly resilient, impact-resistant materials, this lightweight framework handles accidental drops, backpack stuffing, and twists without snapping under pressure.

Adaptive Fit with Steel Adjustor: Ensure a secure, personalized fit that naturally expands as your child grows. The robust headband core features a reinforced steel slider that smoothly adjusts to different head shapes, providing a stable grip that keeps the headphones from slipping off while they move around.

Up to 60 Hours of Playtime: Say goodbye to daily charging chores and unexpected low-battery meltdowns. Packing a massive 60-hour battery reservoir, this kid-friendly headset fuels weeks of school projects, virtual classes, and entertainment blocks on a single full charge cycle.

Seamless Bluetooth Connectivity (v5.4): Enjoy a stress-free wireless connection powered by the advanced Bluetooth v5.4 standard. This stable pipeline connects instantly to family tablets or laptops, giving kids the freedom to stretch out, dance around the room, or move freely without experiencing annoying audio cutouts or drops.

Convenient Type-C Charging: Refuel the device quickly and easily using the universal Type-C port standard. The symmetrical plug layout makes it incredibly simple for older kids to plug in independently, matching the same charging cords used by modern family devices.

Easy Controls with Built-in Mic: Empower your child with intuitive, highly accessible physical buttons designed specifically for smaller hands. An integrated high-sensitivity microphone catches their voice clearly during online school interactions, keeping them connected with teachers and friends.
